notes: Proof House on Ethereum mainnet, first drop ARTIFACTS (THE SOURCE by auction first, then 255 editions). No fungible token or pool. IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) is the existing ERC-20 buyers may pay with for plain SVG collections. BrokerPass: 100 free passes, claimed with an ARTIFACTS piece or an identity.md seat (0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d); holders are Proof House brokers. After deployment the owner calls ArtHouse.setBrokerPass, approves the artist, registers ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource as sale modules and module collections, sets THE SOURCE's split to 15/0/85, configures VRF, and calls ArtStorage.setHouse.
